answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> False Sects Question ID: 39175 Country: India Title: I have one friend he is Siddiq Deendar. He says he is Sunni Question: I have one friend he is Siddiq Deendar. He says he is Sunni. What are their beliefs? Can you please say me about Siddiq Deendar? Can we marry with them (like Boy or Girl)? Can we pray back of them? Can we attend their marriages or functions? I need complete details. Answer ID: 39175 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 362/366/N=1433) According to the Ulama, your friend who calls himself Siddiq Deendar attributing towards the person i.e. Siddiq Hussain alias Siddiq Deendar alias Srichan Basu Yashwar, founder of Deendar Anjuman, he is kafir, apostate and out of folk of Islam due to his various kurfiya and shirkiya beliefs. And those who consider him leader and agree with his beliefs and thoughts they too are kafir, apostate and out of the folk of Islam. It is unlawful and haram to offer salah behind them, to marry them, to participate in their marriage or invite them in marriages etc. They are not follower of the belief of Ahl Sunnah wal Jamah at all. The beliefs of Ahl Sunnah wal Jamah are mentioned in the books of beliefs (like Aqidah al-Tahavi and Talimuddin etc). Hence, your friend is quite wrong to call himself Sunni. They are not Sunni at all, rather they are kafir and apostate. If you want to learn more about this group then read the booklet named ‘Bhed Ki Surat Me Bhediya, in Ahsanul Fatawa’ Vol. 1 p. 215-282). Also you can study the book “Sri Chin Basu Yashwar, Apni Tahrirat O Nazriyat Ke Ayine Me” written by Maulana Muhammad Abdul Qawi Sahib, published by Majlis Ilmiya, Andhra Pradesh, Akbarabad Malikpet, Hyderabad, AP, phone no. 040-24540177). Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
